$comment: Declarative record of every approved content release promoted into the publication directory, per project-workflow.md v1.1 steps 3 and 4. Every entry MUST carry `sha256` — the checksum from the approved content release record. scripts/import-content.mjs verifies it, and runs the encoding and Markdown integrity checks in src/lib/content/integrity.ts, BEFORE any transformation. A missing checksum, a mismatch, or any integrity failure aborts the import; the defect returns to ChatGPT for a corrected release artifact and is never repaired here. Only after integrity passes does the script apply the transformations permitted by workflow section 8.
